faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Are the study resources really free?
faq.a1: Yes! All videos, PDFs, and practice questions are free resources available on the internet. You're paying for the curation, structure, and progress tracking that CoursePath provides.
faq.q2: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.a2: Absolutely. You can cancel your Pro subscription at any time. You'll continue to have access until the end of your billing period.
faq.q3: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a3: We accept all major credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay through our secure payment partner.
faq.a4: Yes, we offer a 7-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans. If you're not satisfied, contact us for a full refund.
faq.a5: Yes! We're constantly adding new certifications based on job market demand. Pro subscribers get access to new certifications as they launch.

about.title: About CoursePath
about.missionText: We believe everyone deserves a clear path to career advancement. CoursePath was built to solve a simple problem: getting certified shouldn't be confusing or expensive.
about.storyText: CoursePath started when we realized that all the resources to pass certification exams already exist for free on the internet — they're just scattered and unorganized. We created a platform that curates these resources into structured, easy-to-follow roadmaps so you can focus on learning, not searching.

v1.title: Accessibility
